text: dsh-developer（DSH 插件，Web/CLI 客户端）：为 DSH 插件与核心开发提供技能、命令和工具，覆盖项目创建与检查、故障诊断、兼容性评估及开发验证。它把 dsh-developer 技能注册给 agent，并提供插件审查、服务预检、版本能力检查、升级影响分析、Creator 导出提升等命令；也注册原生工具和受限的本地浏览器操作。适合编写或维护 DSH 插件、排查启动问题及验证 Web 集成的开发者。需要本机 DSH 与 Node.js，不需要额外 API Key。

dsh-developer (DSH Web/CLI plugin): helps developers build, diagnose, and verify DSH plugins. It registers an agent skill and commands for audits, service checks, compatibility, and upgrade impact, plus native development and local browser tools. Requires local DSH and Node.js; no extra API key.
我想在 DSH 里开发并验证自己的插件。
DSH 插件启动不了，能帮我查出缺了什么服务吗？
想检查插件能否兼容当前和预览版 DSH。
怎么确认插件的 Web 界面集成能正常工作？
Help me diagnose why my DSH plugin will not start.
I need to check a plugin against DSH release and preview versions.
dsh-developer 的功能「插件目录或 Creator 导出审查」：dsh-developer-doctor 命令读取指定项目并输出诊断报告。
dsh-developer 的功能「插件服务预检」：dsh-developer-preflight 命令针对干净 DSH profile 检查所需服务。
dsh-developer 的功能「版本兼容检查」：dsh-developer-compatibility 命令对指定 release 与 preview DSH 执行插件验证。
dsh-developer 的功能「开发项目验证」：开发工作流接收项目源码及工具用例，并通过本机 DSH 验证插件行为。
dsh-developer 的功能「本地浏览器操作」：dsh_ui 工具允许对 loopback 页面执行受限浏览器操作，输入操作与目标并返回页面结果。
想把 Creator 导出整理成可测试的插件目录。
I want to inspect DSH capabilities and compatibility evidence.

dsh-developer README · dsh-developer： **English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) > **The single plugin you need for DSH** dsh-developer brings creation, diagnosis, testing and upgrade checks into one workflow inside DSH or Codex. Describe what you want to build, work with your agent, and check that the result actually works with DSH before you share it. [](https://github.com/builtin-pb/dsh-developer/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](LICENSE)

dsh-developer README · What can you build?：- **A plugin from an idea.** Turn a local service, tool or workflow into something your DSH agent can use.
- **A plugin people can rely on.** Find installation problems, missing services and broken Web integrations before users encounter them.
- **An upgrade with fewer surprises.** See what changed in DSH and check your plugin against release and preview versions.
- **A contribution to DSH itself.** Investigate a missing capability, test the existing behavior and develop a focused improvement against an upstream checkout.
dsh-developer README · What can you build?：Already have a plugin? Start there. You don't need to regenerate it or adopt a new project structure.

dsh-developer README · Install：Install the published `v0.1.4` tag into DSH Web:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:builtin-pb/dsh-developer#v0.1.4' --ignore-scripts
```

Open or restart DSH Web (`dsh web`). For development from source, use a [checkout installation](docs/contributing.md). [Need DSH first?](docs/install.md) · [Using Codex?](docs/workflows.md#use-it-from-codex)

dsh-developer README · Just tell it what you want：> Build a plugin that lets my agent search our local documentation.

> This plugin won't start in DSH Web. Find the problem and fix it.

> Check whether this plugin is ready to share.

The agent picks up the workflow from your request. Describe the goal, answer any questions, and review the changes—no special commands to remember.
section: Just tell it what you want

dsh-developer README · Go further：Version **0.1.4** targets **DSH 0.1.5-rc.2** for blocking checks and **0.1.6-alpha.2** for advisory checks. Headless/Web preflight and native verification, product compatibility, delegation and approval checks passed on these exact runtimes. Native development targets Windows, macOS and Linux; these results do not establish every host or isolated provider. Apple isolation on rc.2 also passed four real integration checks; each host still requires provider admission. See [observed results](docs/verification.md) and the [platform guide](docs/platforms.md).

dsh-developer README · dsh-developer： [English](README.md) · **简体中文** > **The single plugin you need for DSH** dsh-developer 把创建、诊断、测试和升级检查整合进 DSH 与 Codex 的日常工作流。告诉智能体你想做什么，一起完成实现，并在分享之前确认它能在 DSH 中正常工作。 [](https://github.com/builtin-pb/dsh-developer/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](LICENSE)

dsh-developer README · 用它做什么？：- **把想法变成插件。** 将本地服务、工具或工作流接入 DSH，让智能体直接使用。
- **做出更可靠的插件。** 提前发现安装失败、服务缺失和 Web 集成问题。
- **更从容地升级。** 了解 DSH 的变化，对照正式版与预览版检查插件。
- **参与 DSH 本身的开发。** 调查缺失的能力，验证现有行为，在上游源码中实现有针对性的改进。

已经有插件？直接从现有仓库开始，无需重新生成项目，也无需改用另一套目录结构。

dsh-developer README · 安装：将已发布的 `v0.1.4` tag 安装到 DSH Web：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:builtin-pb/dsh-developer#v0.1.4' --ignore-scripts
```

当前源码需要[从 checkout 安装](docs/contributing.md)。打开或重启 DSH Web（`dsh web`）。[还没安装 DSH？](docs/install.md) · [使用 Codex？](docs/workflows.md#use-it-from-codex)

dsh-developer README · 然后，直接说你想做什么：> 做一个插件，让智能体能搜索我们的本地文档。

> 这个插件无法在 DSH Web 中启动，找出问题并修好它。

> 检查这个插件是否已经可以分享给别人。

智能体会根据你的请求选择工作流。描述目标、回答必要的问题、检查修改结果即可，无需记住专门的命令。
section: 然后，直接说你想做什么
